'_53' is the per-event dispatch-table index 0x53 (entry @ 0x51CDD in table @ 0x51B91), a legitimate domain ID, NOT address residue. '__unref' is accurate: 0 direct callers, referenced only by the dispatch table (xref solely from 0x51CDD [DATA]); no chapter FDFIELD turn-event/tile-step hook reaches this slot. 'dialog_with_state' is the shared category descriptor used identically by its twin handler_35 (fd2_chapter_event_handler_35__ch23_mech_boss_defeat); renaming only this one would break that family consistency, and the handler genuinely is a dialog handler. purpose: Chapter event dispatch handler for table index 0x53: show inline dialog page 8, then mass-kill every runtime_char slot from index 0x14 to the end (cinematic terminator-style mass kill).
logic_summary: Watcom __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue, then a single 9-arg cdecl call to fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=8, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) followed by fd2_kill_runtime_chars_from_index_to_end(0x14). In the binary the kill call is reached by 'PUSH 0x14; JMP 0x35354', borrowing the Class-3 shared tail (CALL fd2_kill_runtime_chars_from_index_to_end; ADD ESP,4; RET) hosted inside handler_35 @ 0x35354 as a code-size optimisation; the functionally-exact source is just the two sequential calls. Differs from handler_35 @ 0x35321 only in dialog page (8 vs 5) and kill-from index (0x14 vs 0x12); all other dialog args are byte-identical. The event_arg parameter is ignored.
